title: [Bug]: Auto-compaction is clamped to 256,000 tokens (0x3E800) on models advertised and displayed with a 1,048,576-token window (v1.5.1)

labels.name: duplicate
labels.description: This issue or pull request already exists

labels.name: feedback
labels.description: Feedback on agy cli (other than performance issues etc)

body:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> **This report concerns a mismatch between the published specification and the shipped binary, so it is filed as a bug.**
> The same behavior is already reported in #1245, #878, #1291, and #1371. Those issues were labeled `feedback` or `feature request`, and none has an engineering response as of CLI `1.5.1`. This issue records the mismatch at the instruction level, against the current release, so it can be tracked as a defect.

Gemini 4 Argon is registered, documented, and shown in `/context` with a 1,048,576-token window. `cortex/utils/utils.GetCheckpointConfig` then clamps the auto-compaction threshold to a hardcoded 256,000 tokens (`0x3E800`), which is 25% of the advertised window. The clamp applies to every model and is still present byte-for-byte in `1.5.1`. Google staff confirmed on 2026-11-04 in forum thread [#198191](https://discuss.ai.google.dev/t/enable-larger-than-250k-gemini-context-sizes-in-antigravity-desktop/198191) that the threshold *"is a fixed default and isn't user-configurable yet."*

### Antigravity CLI Version

`1.5.1` (official release binary, 240,857,488 bytes, BuildID `696031ae34e5e5e26a9d7c436e85317f`, SHA-256 `72738cf0445918483956a5f0da33abdfcfb21a12dd9a421fd57d063782826669`). The same clamp is present in `1.5.0` and in Desktop `v2.29.0`.

### Environment Context

- **OS:** Linux x86-64 (WSL2 Ubuntu)
- **Shell:** bash
- **Terminal Emulator:** not relevant; the behavior is in the compaction logic and has also been reported on Windows (#1291)
- **Runtime Version:** official release binary, unmodified (SHA-256 above)
- **Hardware Details:** not relevant

### Steps to Reproduce

1. Install the official `1.5.1` release with the official installer and confirm `agy --version` prints `1.5.1`.
2. Select **Gemini 4 Argon**. `/context` reports a total window of about 1.0M tokens.
3. Work in one conversation until the context passes about 250K tokens. Auto-compaction triggers between roughly 250K and 256K and replaces the history with a summary of about 15K–17K tokens.
4. In the conversation's SQLite database (`~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/conversations/<id>.db`), every model call records `ContextWindowMetadata.max_context_tokens = 256000`.
5. To see the clamp in the binary itself, read 14 bytes at file offset `0x7fb0fe2`:
   ```
   xxd -s 0x7fb0fe2 -l 14 -p "$(readlink -f "$(command -v agy)")"
   81fa00e80300be00e803000f42f2
   ```
   These bytes decode to `cmp $0x3e800,%edx; mov $0x3e800,%esi; cmovb %edx,%esi`. The sequence occurs once in `.text`.

### Expected Behavior

The compaction threshold should match the context window that the product advertises and displays. `GetCheckpointConfig` already computes that value before the clamp: the registered window minus a per-model margin of at least 40,000 tokens (983,040 for Gemini 4 Argon). Either of the following would resolve this issue:

1. Remove the `min(calculated, 256000)` clamp, so models registered at 1,048,576 tokens compact near their computed threshold.
2. If 256K is an intended product limit, state it in the documentation and model listings, show the real threshold in `/context`, and provide a documented setting that works for every model. `AGY_CLI_AUTO_COMPACT_OVERRIDE` could serve, but see the limits below.

### Actual Behavior / Error Screenshots

| Item | Finding |
|---|---|
| Model registration | `defaultmodels.Gemini4Argon` sets the window to `0x100000` (1,048,576) |
| Clamp | `cmp $0x3e800,%edx; mov $0x3e800,%esi; cmovb %edx,%esi` in `GetCheckpointConfig`, sole occurrence in `.text`: CLI `1.5.1` file offset `0x7fb0fe2`, CLI `1.5.0` `0x7fe5802`, Desktop `v2.29.0` `language_server.exe` `0x176cca2` |
| Recorded limit | 15,575 of 15,575 model calls (209 local 1M-Gemini CLI sessions) record `max_context_tokens = 256000`; #878 reports 65,613 calls over 310 sessions with a maximum single-call input of 255,999 and no calls above 300K |
| Cost of each compaction | Median 70 s stall; the summary call's tokens are not recorded in `gen_metadata`; the 240K+ implicit prompt cache is lost and rebuilt with an uncached call (#1291) |
| Larger tiers | `512K` (`1.3x`) and `900K` (`1.8x`, `Expensive: true`) options exist in the binary but are gated by a one-entry `"Gemini 4 Argon"` whitelist (`v1.5.0` data VA `0xc592be0`) |
| `AGY_CLI_AUTO_COMPACT_OVERRIDE` | Compiled out in `1.3.5`–`1.4.x`. Read again from `1.5.0`, with no `CHANGELOG.md` entry. In `1.5.1` both calls to its parser pass a base of `0` (`xor %eax,%eax` before the calls at VA `0x9c34c9a` and `0x9e875aa`), so the percentage form is ignored. `Store.ContextWindow()` reads it only after the whitelist check and only when no tier is saved in `settings.json`. The 256,000 clamp still follows it |
| Official position | #198191 (2026-11-04): the ~250K threshold is a fixed default and not user-configurable; the request was passed to engineering with no timeline |

### Logs & Configurations

Analyzed binaries (no binaries are redistributed; all come from Google's own storage):

| CLI `1.5.0` `cli_linux_x64.tar.gz` | `storage.googleapis.com/antigravity-public/antigravity-cli/1.5.0-5269980577660928/linux-x64/` | SHA-512 `e6031f850929210705d8c2393a5665b82b8c3b19684a6d3c556cafa31f26f77acbf164dfee96ca84a5ae7670ac0cc238a974c981c517b269194bdccff271cbd5` (matches the official manifest) |
| Desktop `v2.29.0` `Antigravity-x64.exe` | `storage.googleapis.com/antigravity-public/antigravity-hub/2.29.0-5723181030440960/windows-x64/` | SHA-256 `944b109bcb377f9f94f86eeea7cfa9315d4b42d84fb9d5bad689058fc11c12ba` |
| Desktop `language_server.exe` (bundled) | inside the installer above | SHA-256 `c98e7c331da5bcc37002a550e7d625b4c636f775fa2804f73777c6a500e1c3d5` |
